_doc.mode: translate (faithful full translation, client-facing styling) or study-guide
_doc.lang: code from references/languages.md (gu, hi, ur, ta, zh, ar ...); 'latin' for any Latin-script language
_doc.output: final PDF path, relative to this file - this is the file to deliver
_doc.running_header: small text at the top of every page except the cover
_doc.cover: code line, title, subtitles, note (what this is, how terms are handled, what to verify)
_doc.units[].label / title / source_title: contents-page text: label · target title (source title)
_doc.units[].part_heading: optional group heading printed in the contents before this unit
_doc.units[].match: exact text of the unit's chcover .code line - used to find its start page
_doc.units[].match_extra: extra text that must be on the same page (tells parts of a split chapter apart)
_doc.unit_page_break: true (default) starts each unit on a new page; false for short documents
_doc.optional: font, dir, line_height, heading_line_height override references/languages.md; extra_css is appended
